"Tum goals pe nahi—tum system pe rise/ fall karte."
Tumhara time limited hai.
Aaj kuch aisa karo jiske liye future self tumhe thank you kahe.
Motivation nahi tikti; system banao jo tikta.
Main apni circumstances ka product nahi hoon.
Aise seekho jaise hamesha jina hai, aise jiyo jaise kal marna hai.
Plans worthless, par planning sab kuch.
Agar jo chahiye kabhi nahi tha, toh jo kabhi nahi kiya—wo karo.
Sahi disha mein chhote steps sabse bade ban sakte hain.
"Jitni zyada mehnat, utni zyada luck."
Tum khud ko limit mat karo.
